items.name: TREMOLO_RATE_RANGE
items.doc: The tremolo's LFO rate (the catalogue row's 0.1..20 Hz); 4 Hz is the classic amp tremolo.

items.name: TREMOLO_DEPTH_RANGE
items.doc: The tremolo's modulation depth: the gain's trough is `1 − mix·depth`.

items.name: TREMOLO_MIX_RANGE
items.doc: The tremolo's wet/dry, as an instance of DRIVE_MIX_RANGE: 100 %. The kernel folds the wet/dry into its one gain, so a strip tremolo IS the sound (as the rotary's mix 100 % is).

items.name: TREMOLO_TRAVELS
items.doc: The tremolo's numeric travels, field → declaration: the ONE map the row's state, its bounds, its OPTIONS and its controller read (`mode` is a member set, TREMOLO_MODES, beside it).

items.name: TREMOLO_MODES

source.origin: omx-dsp 6d6fcda include/omxdsp/fx/omx_tremolo.h enum omx_tremolo_mode; omx-plugins 3778732 recipes/examples/omx-tremolo.answers.json (TREMOLO_MODES)

items.doc: What the tremolo's one oscillator modulates, in the order of the integer the kernel reads: the level of both legs in phase (tremolo), or the balance law's position with the legs in opposition (pan).
